rules: Every bug found and not fixed goes here. status: open | fixed | waived. severity: field-critical (loses work, bricks the app, or ships wrong data) | major | minor. Ship gate blocks on open field-critical unless director_waiver is set. rank = Director-approved order.

bugs.title: A failed update can make the app close on every launch
bugs.detail: Relaunch loop when a staged update fails to apply; pending state is never cleared.

bugs.title: No rollback if copying update files fails partway
bugs.detail: Install folder can be left half old, half new.

bugs.title: A leftover older staged update can downgrade the app
bugs.detail: Staged version is not compared against the running version before applying.

bugs.title: Updating from inside the app skips saving your work
bugs.detail: Updater path calls sys.exit without the normal close/persist sequence.

bugs.title: In-app update helper hung forever: launched with no console, tasklist|find never returned, so the update never installed and the app never reopened
bugs.detail: Found by adversarial review; confirmed old flags never finish from a windowed parent. Now CREATE_NO_WINDOW + tasklist to file.

bugs.title: OPEN_APP.bat / FINISH_UPDATE.bat installed any staged update with no completeness check
bugs.detail: Launcher now requires update_ready/.complete (written last by the app).

bugs.title: A half-copied staged update (disk full) could be installed and leave an app that will not start
bugs.detail: Found by second review pass. .complete sentinel; partial copy dropped without blocking re-download.

bugs.title: Picking in the Together view loses picks and Apply loops
bugs.detail: Together restored an empty pick list, and Apply did not name the day so the pick queue started over.

bugs.title: "Pick order..." resets other days to file order
bugs.detail: Reloading Excel/.EST for a new pick replaced every day's visit order. Other days now keep theirs.

bugs.title: Merging days leaves each day's route out of date
bugs.detail: Merge reordered every site but left each day's saved line on the old visit order. Each day is now retraced in the new order; a day that fails to trace drops the old line.

bugs.title: Drive times are wrong when a day filter is on
bugs.detail: Day-filtered time legs were indexed by the full stop list. Route and install clocks now use that day's own order.

bugs.title: Pick mode stays active after switching to the Install tab
bugs.detail: Leaving Route pauses pick mode. Install map clicks select the site and Drop pin is available. The unapplied order returns when Route is opened again.

bugs.title: A site ID can falsely match coordinate digits inside a map file
bugs.detail: .EST word-boundary site-ID match hits digits inside coordinates.

bugs.title: Duplicate site IDs: import keeps the first copy, export keeps the last
A title row above the headers finds zero sites
bugs.detail: Excel header-row detection assumes headers are on row 1.

bugs.title: Large or retried road downloads lose roads that cross tile edges
Going online freezes the screen during street lookup and can overwrite typed streets
local_server reads whole files into memory for every request
